data.title: Shorten spectrogram window to reduce renderer load

data.body: Implemented scoped spectrogram load reduction: default spectrogram window is now 10s, selectable windows are 4/10/20/30s, and retained PSD history is pruned to the most recent 45s instead of keeping 7200 snapshots. Verification: npm run build:frontend passed.

Completed scoped implementation and verification. Changed eeg/frontend/src/components/graphs/SpectralHistoryPanel.tsx so spectrogram defaults to 10s, available windows are 4/10/20/30s, and PSD history is pruned to the most recent 45s rather than retaining/reprocessing 7200 snapshots. npm run build:frontend passed. A post-change process snapshot showed the live EEG renderer around 21.6% CPU / 505 MB RSS, down from the prior diagnostic snapshot around 147% CPU / 709 MB RSS. Existing unrelated dirty files were left untouched.
